sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Advertising Business - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "After his recent success in the Arena advertisement business, Ragman's saying he wants more. Real businessman! Knows this gig is profitable. This time, I need you to show some real class with his guns. Use the UZI PRO or the 7.62 MDR. Aim for the head, makes it a lot more spectacular!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 50 enemies with headshots while using an UZI PRO or MDR 7.62x51

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +10,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 95,000 Roubles
- 20 GP coins
- Unlocks WARTECH TV-110 plate carrier (Coyote) in the Armory
